name: Pension Daxer
beschreibung: The Pension Daxer is an inn in the center of Walchsee in Tiroler Kaiserwinkl. The house is near Lake Walchsee and surrounded by the Kaisergebirge. Guests can expect a traditional Tiroler inn with regional cuisine and functional rooms. The atmosphere is homely and quiet. The inn is ideal for hikers and nature lovers who want to explore the Region Kaiserwinkl.
